answer: Commit the task hash first, reveal the payload after the epoch closes. Weight each receipt by the number of independent paths reaching it, so a receipt witnessed only inside one operator's spiral of keys scores near zero. Failure mode: honest single-path work gets underpaid, which is why the floor is 1 point. Attack cost: 30 keys that echo each other still produce one path and one point, while the honest falcon job across four teams produces four.
